subject: Re: DPA addendum, TIA scoping and subprocessors - PrivaHealth kickoff
messages:
From: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@privahealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: DPA addendum & TIA scoping for PrivaHealth

Hi Hannah / Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. We’re ready to start the DPA addendum for our UK footprint and want to make sure the TIA/DTIA scoping captures our use of regional cache nodes and a downstream analytics subprocessor in Ireland. Key asks so we can scope procurement: 

- Please advise whether Redwood intends to present the standalone UK IDTA or the UK Addendum flow for signing. Our legal team prefers the Addendum if it reduces back-and-forth.
- We need a full current list of subprocessors, including location and purpose.
- Signing order: do you require Redwood legal first or can we do parallel review with our procurement?
- Proposed target: contract sign-off by 2029-04-30 to align with our launch window. Is that achievable on your side?

Attached: PrivaHealth_TIA_Scope_v1.xlsx, Subprocessor_Questions.docx

Thanks,

Maria Fernandez
Senior Privacy Counsel
PrivaHealth

--Attachment: PrivaHealth_TIA_Scope_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
--Attachment: Subprocessor_Questions.docx (application/msword)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@privahealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: DPA addendum & TIA scoping for PrivaHealth

Hi Maria,

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick read of your attachments looks good. To answer your bullets:

- Recommended approach: we can do the UK Addendum as the primary path (shorter cycle) and hold the UK IDTA as a fallback if legal requests changes that require the full agreement. We’ll flag any clause that would force the IDTA route.
- Subprocessor list: I’m attaching an internal draft of the UK_Addendum_Draft_v1.docx and an annotated TIA spreadsheet that calls out cache nodes and analytics flow. Jonas will populate the subprocessors CSV for you by EOD.
- Signing order: Redwood prefers Redwood legal -> PrivaHealth legal for the first pass, but we can do parallel reviews if your procurement prefers that to speed things up.

Timeline: we can target internal sign-off by 2029-04-20 and DocuSign by 2029-04-26 if we keep to this cadence. If PrivaHealth needs the parallel review route we can compress a week.

Next steps:
1) Jonas to share subprocessors_list.csv and our technical controls checklist.
2) Legal to review UK_Addendum_Draft_v1.docx and call out any redlines in the linked Drive folder.
3) We will issue a DocuSign envelope once mutual redlines are closed.

I’ve attached the drafts here.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: UK_Addendum_Draft_v1.docx (application/msword)
--Attachment: TIA_Scoping_annotated.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@privahealth.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-10T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: DPA addendum & TIA scoping for PrivaHealth

Thanks Maria / Hannah,

I’m on the subprocessors ask. I’ve attached the current exportable list and included location and data purpose columns. I’ll run our technical-controls checklist against the TIA scoping this afternoon and flag any gaps (esp. for the analytics subprocessors and cache nodes).

I expect to have the subprocessors_list.csv over to you by 2029-04-10 17:00 PDT. If you need it earlier for procurement, let me know and I’ll prioritize.

Jonas

--Attachment: subprocessors_list.csv (text/csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@privahealth.com>, privahealth-legal@privahealth.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: DPA addendum & TIA scoping for PrivaHealth

Hi Maria,

Great to be moving quickly. We received Jonas’ CSV and I noted one analytics subprocessor uses an Irish processing cluster; we have called that out in the annotated TIA.

For the sign cadence we will follow Redwood legal -> PrivaHealth legal as our default, but we are happy to accelerate with parallel review if your procurement wants it. To keep the procurement deadline you quoted (2029-04-30), please confirm by end of day tomorrow whether you prefer parallel review.

I’ve prepared the DocuSign envelope and will populate it once your legal confirms no material redlines to the Addendum draft. Link below. Expect a sign request once we close the redline loop.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEFG1234567890
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPrivaHealth-TIA
Jira: PRIV-1287 (internal tracker)

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

--Note: internal checklist run by Jonas attached to thread earlier.
